newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-VENTER BANNED FOR THREE WEEKS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-VENTER BANNED FOR THREE WEEKS.

text.p: South African rugby flanker Andre Venter was suspended for three weeks on Sunday for stamping on New Zealand captain Sean Fitzpatrick's head during Saturday's Tri-Nations test at Eden Park.
The New Zealand Rugby Football Union made the announcement after a judicial hearing into the incident.
Venter received the first red card of the Tri-Nations series, being sent off after stamping on the face of the All Black captain early in the second half of the test match.
The Springboks were forced to play the rest of the game with only 14 men.
New Zealand won the match 55-35 -- the highest score an All Black side has ever posted against South Africa and the largest winning margin.
